A neural network is @@T0@@equivariant@@T.zh: 当旋转输入会使输出以同样的方式旋转时，我们称神经网络对该变换@@T0@@等变@@T1@@。对于卫星影像、分子、点云，以及任何没有特殊优越朝向的系统，这正是你所需要的，而大多数普通网络无法提供。
A neural network is @@T0@@equivariant@@T.src: A neural network is equivariant to a transformation when rotating the input rotates the output the same way. For satellite imagery, molecules, point clouds, and any system without a privileged orientation, this is what you want and most vanilla networks don't deliver it.

@@T0@@~16 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Ind.zh:
@@T0@@约 16 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@归纳偏置 · 对称性 · CNN@@T3@@

$f$ is @@T0@@equivariant@@T1@@ to a tran.zh: 若把 $T_g$ 施加于输入所产生的效果，等同于对输出施加某个（可能不同的）变换，则称 $f$ 对变换 $T_g$ @@T0@@等变@@T1@@。@@T2@@不变@@T3@@ 是输出完全不变的特殊情形。
$f$ is @@T0@@equivariant@@T1@@ to a tran.src: $f$ is equivariant to a transformation $T_g$ if applying $T_g$ to the input has the same effect as applying some (possibly different) transformation to the output. Invariance is the special case where the output doesn't change at all.

@@T0@@Translation equivariance.@@T1@@ Mo.zh: @@T0@@平移等变。@@T1@@ 把物体横向移动 —— 特征图也随之平移。标准 CNN 卷积免费为你提供了这种性质（在填充的边界考虑之外）。
@@T0@@Translation equivariance.@@T1@@ Mo.src: Translation equivariance. Move an object sideways — feature maps shift the same way. Standard CNN convolution gives you this for free (modulo padding).

@@T0@@Rotation equivariance.@@T1@@ Rotat.zh: @@T0@@旋转等变。@@T1@@ 把输入旋转 90° —— 特征图也旋转 90°。标准 CNN @@T2@@并不具备@@T3@@ 这一性质；你需要 C4 群卷积（Cohen & Welling，2016）。
@@T0@@Rotation equivariance.@@T1@@ Rotat.src: Rotation equivariance. Rotate the input by 90° — feature maps rotate by 90° too. Standard CNNs don't have this; you'd need C4 group convolutions (Cohen & Welling, 2016).

@@T0@@Scale equivariance.@@T1@@ Zoom in.zh: @@T0@@尺度等变。@@T1@@ 放大 —— 特征随之缩放。大多通过金字塔来近似；真正的等变架构存在，但较为罕见。
@@T0@@Scale equivariance.@@T1@@ Zoom in.src: Scale equivariance. Zoom in — features scale. Mostly approximated via pyramids; true equivariant architectures exist but are rare.

@@T0@@SE(3) equivariance.@@T1@@ 3-D rigi.zh: @@T0@@SE(3) 等变。@@T1@@ 三维刚体对称性。对分子 / 点云至关重要（E(3)NN、SE(3)-Transformer）。
@@T0@@SE(3) equivariance.@@T1@@ 3-D rigi.src: SE(3) equivariance. 3-D rigid-body symmetries. Critical for molecules / point clouds (E(3)NN, SE(3)-Transformer).

@@T0@@Permutation equivariance.@@T1@@ Se.zh: @@T0@@置换等变。@@T1@@ 集合与图。自注意力具有置换等变性；GNN 的聚合操作亦然。
@@T0@@Permutation equivariance.@@T1@@ Se.src: Permutation equivariance. Sets and graphs. Self-attention is permutation-equivariant; GNN aggregations are too.

Why a vanilla CNN can't rotate.zh: 为何普通 CNN 无法旋转
Why a vanilla CNN can't rotate.src: Why a vanilla CNN can't rotate

A standard 3×3 convolution filter is a f.zh: 标准的 3×3 卷积滤波器是像素空间中一个固定的模式。旋转输入并不会旋转该滤波器；响应会剧烈抖动。三种经典补救办法：
A standard 3×3 convolution filter is a f.src:
A standard 3×3 convolution filter is a fixed pattern in pixel
          space. Rotating the input does not rotate the filter; the
          response thrashes. Three classical fixes:

@@T0@@Data augmentation.@@T1@@ Train wit.zh: @@T0@@数据增强。@@T1@@ 用随机旋转进行训练。代价低廉；对分类几乎有效；其响应近似不变但并非等变，而且模型仍须冗余地学习每一种旋转。
@@T0@@Data augmentation.@@T1@@ Train wit.src: Data augmentation. Train with random rotations. Cheap; nearly works for classification; the response is approximately invariant but not equivariant, and the model still has to learn each rotation redundantly.

@@T0@@Group convolutions (G-CNN).@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@群卷积（G-CNN）。@@T1@@ 在每一层施加同一滤波器的 $k$ 个旋转副本；特征图因此多出一个「旋转」轴。Cohen & Welling 2016；可证明具有等变性。
@@T0@@Group convolutions (G-CNN).@@T1@@.src: Group convolutions (G-CNN). Apply $k$ rotated copies of the same filter at each layer; the feature map has an extra "rotation" axis. Cohen & Welling 2016; provably equivariant.

@@T0@@Steerable CNNs.@@T1@@ Use filters.zh: @@T0@@可操纵 CNN。@@T1@@ 使用在旋转下连续变换的滤波器（圆谐波的线性组合）。对连续的 $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ 群等变，而不仅限于离散群。
@@T0@@Steerable CNNs.@@T1@@ Use filters.src: Steerable CNNs. Use filters that transform continuously under rotation (linear combinations of circular harmonics). Equivariant to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ group, not just discrete.

Live: rotate the input, watch three arch.zh: 实战：旋转输入，观察三种架构的响应
Live: rotate the input, watch three arch.src: Live: rotate the input, watch three architectures respond

A synthetic airplane-silhouette input is.zh: 一个合成的飞机剪影输入被旋转了 θ。三个微小的网络各自输出一个特征向量。绘制 θ=0 处的特征与当前 θ 处特征之间的 L2 距离。完全不变的网络会给出一条恒为零的平直线；完全等变的网络会呈现出一条干净的轨道形状。普通 CNN 的响应则杂乱无章。
A synthetic airplane-silhouette input is.src:
A synthetic airplane-silhouette input is rotated by θ. Three
          tiny networks emit a feature vector. Plot the L2 distance
          between the feature at θ=0 and the feature at the current θ.
          A perfectly invariant network would output a flat line at
          zero; a perfectly equivariant one would show a clean orbit
          shape. The vanilla CNN responds erratically.

Feature distance from θ=0, swept over θ.zh: 相对 θ=0 的特征距离，随 θ 扫描
Feature distance from θ=0, swept over θ.src: Feature distance from θ=0, swept over θ

@@T0@@Satellite / aerial imagery.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@卫星 / 航拍影像。@@T1@@ Sentinel 与 Landsat 瓦片没有规范的「上」方向；航拍 / 无人机影像随平台一起旋转。可用于骨干网络的有 C4 / C8 群卷积，或旋转增强 + 测试时对多个旋转取平均。
@@T0@@Satellite / aerial imagery.@@T1@@.src: Satellite / aerial imagery. Sentinel and Landsat tiles have no canonical "up"; aerial / drone footage rotates with the platform. C4 / C8 group convolutions on the backbone, or rotation augmentation + test-time average-of-rotations.

@@T0@@Molecular & atomic systems.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@分子与原子体系。@@T1@@ 能量对刚性旋转不变；而力是等变的。在分子机器学习中可使用 E(3)NN、SE(3)-Transformer、MACE；AlphaFold-2 的不变点注意力也属于这一族。
@@T0@@Molecular & atomic systems.@@T1@@.src: Molecular & atomic systems. Energies are invariant to rigid rotations; forces are equivariant. Use E(3)NN, SE(3)-Transformer, MACE for molecular ML; AlphaFold-2's invariant point attention is in this family.

@@T0@@Point clouds.@@T1@@ 3-D LiDAR / sc.zh: @@T0@@点云。@@T1@@ 三维 LiDAR / 扫描数据需要 SE(3) 等变，才能实现尊重传感器安装方式的物体检测。
@@T0@@Point clouds.@@T1@@ 3-D LiDAR / sc.src: Point clouds. 3-D LiDAR / scans need SE(3) equivariance for object detection that respects how you mounted the sensor.

@@T0@@Sets and graphs.@@T1@@ Permutation.zh: @@T0@@集合与图。@@T1@@ 置换等变是毫无商量余地的：GNN、Deep Sets、transformer（不含位置编码）都属于这一范畴。
@@T0@@Sets and graphs.@@T1@@ Permutation.src: Sets and graphs. Permutation equivariance is non-negotiable: GNNs, Deep Sets, transformers (without positional encoding) all sit here.

@@T0@@Medical 3-D volumes.@@T1@@ CT / MR.zh: @@T0@@医学三维体数据。@@T1@@ 患者体位被旋转的 CT / MRI / PET。旋转等变有助于小数据微调的泛化。
@@T0@@Medical 3-D volumes.@@T1@@ CT / MR.src: Medical 3-D volumes. CT / MRI / PET with rotated patient pose. Rotation equivariance helps small-data fine-tunes generalise.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Equiv.zh:
@@T0@@一句话口号。@@T1@@
          等变性是伪装起来的数据效率。无法旋转的网络不得不分别学习每一种旋转；而等变网络把旋转视为一种对称性，将自身容量花在真正重要的部分上。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Equiv.src: The slogan. Equivariance is data efficiency in disguise. A network that can't rotate has to learn every rotation separately; an equivariant network sees the rotation as a symmetry and spends its capacity on the parts that actually matter.

@@T0@@Discrete vs continuous group.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@离散群与连续群。@@T1@@ C4（90°）与 C8（45°）易于实现；连续 SO(2) 则需要可操纵滤波器或谐波网络。
@@T0@@Discrete vs continuous group.@@T1@.src: Discrete vs continuous group. C4 (90°) and C8 (45°) are easy to implement; continuous SO(2) requires steerable filters or harmonic networks.

@@T0@@Cost.@@T1@@ A C4 group conv has 4×.zh: @@T0@@代价。@@T1@@ C4 群卷积的通道数是普通卷积的 4 倍；训练与推理代价也相应放大。现代硬件可以承受。
@@T0@@Cost.@@T1@@ A C4 group conv has 4×.src: Cost. A C4 group conv has 4× the channels of a vanilla conv; train and inference cost scale accordingly. Modern hardware tolerates it.

@@T0@@Combine with augmentation, don't r.zh:
@@T0@@与增强结合，而非取代它。@@T1@@
            等变 ≠ 不做增强；你仍然需要裁剪、亮度、噪声。等变的那个轴只是把@@T2@@一个@@T3@@变异来源从桌上拿掉而已。
@@T0@@Combine with augmentation, don't r.src: Combine with augmentation, don't replace it. Equivariant ≠ no augmentation; you still want crops, brightness, noise. The equivariant axis takes one source of variation off the table.

@@T0@@Don't equivary the wrong thing.@@T.zh: @@T0@@不要对错误的东西施加等变。@@T1@@ 如果你的任务@@T2@@依赖@@T3@@ 朝向（文字识别、带「上」方向的场景理解），旋转等变就是错的。只在对称性真正存在之处使用它。
@@T0@@Don't equivary the wrong thing.@@T.src: Don't equivary the wrong thing. If your task depends on orientation (text recognition, scene understanding with "up"), rotation equivariance is wrong. Use it where symmetry truly exists.

@@T0@@Libraries.@@T1@@ @@T2@@escnn@@T3@@.zh:
@@T0@@库。@@T1@@ @@T2@@escnn@@T3@@ /
            @@T4@@e2cnn@@T5@@（PyTorch）、@@T6@@se3-transformer@@T7@@（PyTorch）、@@T8@@e3nn@@T9@@（面向分子的 PyTorch）、在 JAX 中进行 SE(3) 等变工作的 @@T10@@jaxon@@T11@@ / @@T12@@JAX-MD@@T13@@。
@@T0@@Libraries.@@T1@@ @@T2@@escnn@@T3@@.src: Libraries. escnn / e2cnn (PyTorch), se3-transformer (PyTorch), e3nn (PyTorch for molecules), jaxon / JAX-MD for SE(3) equivariant work in JAX.

meta.title: 等变网络实战
meta.tagline: 旋转输入——正确的架构会让输出也随之旋转，而普通 CNN 做不到。
meta.summary: 旋转一幅合成输入图像；比较普通 CNN、增强 CNN 与旋转等变网络的响应。观察旋转等变网络给出干净的轨道，而普通 CNN 的响应剧烈抖动。并与卫星与分子深度学习应用相互关联。
highlights: 拖动输入旋转角 θ；观察三种架构对一个被旋转的飞机剪影的响应。
普通 CNN：响应跳变。增强 CNN：变平滑但仍会抖动。C4 群卷积：干净的轨道。
等变与不变：各自何时需要。
超越旋转：尺度、规范、SE(3)、球面、图自同构。
